sources.name: Kevin_Indig
sources.excerpt: OpenAI just updated its dataset on how people use ChatGPT. I went through every file and found a few surprises: 1. Classic Google query types are now about half of all messages - 48% of all messages were Google-style questions in September 2026, up from 43% in July 2024. - The 48% breaks down into 20% simple searches (facts, products, recipes) and 28% Practical Guidance (how-to, tutoring, health, creative ideas). - OpenAI sorts every message into work or personal. Google-style questions make up 53% of personal messages and 38% of work messages (September 2026). - Personal messages grew from 48% to 68% of all messages since July 2024. - Most of the rise comes from personal messages taking a…

AI Search / GEO.what_happened: Google has made recent changes to AI overviews that are brutal for websites. Previously, they would prominently feature…

sources.name: brodieseo
sources.excerpt: Google has made recent changes to AI overviews that are brutal for websites. Previously, they would prominently feature citations for 2-3 domains in visible cards alongside the result. I'm now seeing a drastic reduction in their appearance, so if you are seeing a significant decline in impressions and site visibility in recent days, this is likely a contributing factor. To add insult to injury, AI overviews now display for 83% of all queries on desktop in the US, according to @semrush data, making this even more impactful. Having the prominent citation cards removed on desktop is one that has been the default on mobile for some time now, but it looks like the change is now here to stay.…
sources.author: @brodieseo

sources.name: glenngabe
sources.excerpt: The page is back up. We now have an official post from @Semrush regarding Google poisoning the SERPs. They explain what they are seeing and how they are addressing it. Sure sounds like a PITA to get this right... "Poisoned SERPs generally take two forms. In some cases, the results page as a whole is clearly off, with results that don’t match the query even on page one. In others, the page looks normal at first, but further down the results, it includes pages that only loosely match the search." SERP & Algorithm Signals.what_happened: Pinned: AI Overviews are now triggering for most commercial searches & brand queries. It's worth spending time doing…

sources.name: Marie_Haynes
sources.excerpt: Pinned: AI Overviews are now triggering for most commercial searches & brand queries. It's worth spending time doing some non-personalized searches for brand and money terms. My advice: First, see if everything is accurate. If not, look at where Google is pulling the info from. You can often correct it by changing the copy on your Home or About page. Or, you might find it comes from a third party source. Next, look at your top 10 money keywords. If competitors are cited over you, here's a prompt from the most recent Marie's Notes (for Search Bar Pro) you can run: "I'm analyzing which websites Google cites in AI Overviews for the query [YOUR QUERY].
